title: HostCover Terms: Property-Damage Settlement Percentage by Escalation Timing
content:
Property-damage claims under **Host Damage Protection (HostCover)** are settled according to when the host escalated them. The property escalation share follows the calendar days from the date part of the guest's response deadline to the date part of the host's escalation of the property-damage claim: an escalation 22 to 30 days after the deadline settles the property damage at 90 percent, one 8 to 21 days after at 95 percent, and one 7 days or fewer after in full. The percentage applies to the property loss being settled, before any guest payment or deductible comes off it.

Expressed as bands:

- 7 calendar days or fewer after the deadline date: in full.
- 8 to 21 calendar days after: 95 percent.
- 22 to 30 calendar days after: 90 percent.

## Cases on both sides of each boundary (hypothetical deadline 10 April)

| Escalation date | Days after the deadline date | Settled at |
|---|---|---|
| 17 April | 7 | in full |
| 18 April | 8 | 95 percent |
| 1 May | 21 | 95 percent |
| 2 May | 22 | 90 percent |

A property loss of 4000.00 escalated on 2 May enters the settlement at 3600.00; escalated on 17 April, at 4000.00.
